properties.title: Restoration opportunities and plantation site suitability - India
properties.description: Two layers for restoration planning. The Restoration Opportunities Atlas of WRI India, re-published by CoRE Stack, and the plantation site suitability layer of CoRE Stack (CC BY 4.0 per the sheet). Pan-India.
properties.mosaic:bbox_note: Bbox of the canonical landscape delineation, used as a proxy for the dataset's own (unrecorded) extent.
properties.mosaic:datetime_note: No temporal coverage recorded. datetime is a stand-in: the date the record was catalogued (its registration date), not a time of the data.
properties.mosaic:license_original: Mixed per layer: WRI India atlas re-published by CoRE Stack with no licence stated; plantation site suitability licensed as stated in the CoRE Stack layer sheet
properties.mosaic:access_note: Current location: CoRE Stack: public Google Earth Engine assets and Google Drive downloads, one row per layer in the CoRE Stack GEE Layers Links sheet (WRI restoration opportunities atlas and Plantation Site Suitability groups). Map viewer: https://ee-corestackdev.projects.earthengine.app/view/core-stack-gee-app
